text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So sleepy~. But I ain't givin' up~. This weekend, I'm gonna spend all my time tinker-tinkering with my new gadgets~.

"Go, go, Traaaaineeer.
Freedom lies beyond the paperwork~."

Transcend ended up staying up late
just to make time for her hobby...
